knobs.label: Size
knobs.help: The new clip is at most 4K.

knobs.label: Strength
knobs.help: How much of the model's picture replaces a plain enlargement. At 0 and the same size the model does not run.

knobs.label: Brighten dark scenes
knobs.help: Lifts the shadows of scenes that are too dark, and leaves well-lit ones alone. It also lifts the noise dark footage carries.
